profile.slideContext: XRD results compare powder, SLS and injection-moulded Nylon-12

excludedEvidence.stressStrainCharts: SLS-only specimen curves; not injection-moulded evidence
excludedEvidence.utsCharts: summary/box-plot derived statistics rather than delivered specimen-level direct measurements
excludedEvidence.mdscTableS1: manufacturing route is not explicit enough to assign values to injection moulding
excludedEvidence.otherXrdSeries: powder/SLS/reuse-powder series are not injection-moulded evidence

evidenceBoundary: Only the chart series explicitly identified as Injection Molded Nylon-12 within the XRD comparison slide is accepted as direct injection-moulded characterization evidence. XRD category-axis coordinates, SLS/powder series, SLS stress-strain curves, summary UTS box-plot statistics, and MDSC rows without an explicit injection-moulded route are excluded.
